description: A two-storey stucco home facing the lake. The tiled foyer has a curved staircase and a wrought-iron glass door to an inner courtyard with a fountain and stone paving. The living room has a wall of glass doors with water views and opens to a tiled terrace with two curtained cabanas and a glass railing. The dining room seats twelve under a crystal chandelier, with glass doors to the courtyard. The kitchen has a Viking range with double ovens, a pot filler, arched open shelving and an eat-in table. A family room has built-in arched cabinetry. The primary bedroom has a fireplace, floor-to-ceiling glass doors and a balcony over the water. There is a powder room with a stone sink, and three garage doors face the street.

review_notes: Not Ontario-looking: agave and succulent plants (photo 01, photo 14), Mediterranean stucco with arched colonnades, a large open-water horizon that reads as ocean, and a gnarled coastal tree. Description says lake/water only.
